core: Protein glycosylation precursor synthesis and congenital glycosylation disorders
qualifier: dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor assembly
name: Dolichol-linked N-glycosylation, GPI anchoring and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members cover dolichol, GDP-mannose and nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis, ALG/DPM-step N-glycan assembly with their CDG defects and GPI anchor synthesis, which the sialic acid-focused confusables lack.

name: Selective autophagy variants including microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: All members concern cargo-selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, aggrephagy) and autophagosome regulation, and only this theme holds microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy, unlike the PINK1-mitophagy and aggresome/ERAD confusables.

name: ERBB4 and ERBB3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are ERBB4 homo- and heterodimer signaling, its nuclear and PI3K outputs and downregulation, plus ERBB3 signaling, whereas confusables centre on EGFR/ERBB2, MET, PTK6 or IGF1R.

name: BAF chromatin remodeling complex assembly
rationale: All five members are formation of BAF (SWI/SNF) complex variants (cBAF, ncBAF, pBAF, esBAF, npBAF/nBAF), which no confusable contains.

name: Mitochondrial protein presequence processing and degradation
rationale: Members concern signal peptide processing of mitochondrially targeted proteins and mitochondrial protein catabolism, distinct from confusables about protein import, cristae and SMDT1/calcium processing.

name: Gland, airway and lymphoid organ development
rationale: Members are development of exocrine and endocrine glands (salivary, lacrimal, mammary, thyroid, parathyroid), trachea, bile duct, thymus and spleen, while confusables are craniofacial, ear and limb morphogenesis.

name: Platelet activation via VWF, collagen and agonist receptors
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion through VWF-GPIb and GPVI-collagen, activation by ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors, and degranulation, unlike the coagulation-factor and cytoskeletal or G12/13 confusables.

name: Chromatin remodeler and corepressor regulation of gene transcription
rationale: Members include NuRD, CHD6-9, ChAHP, Polycomb and CTCF modules, arginine methylation and SUMOylation of chromatin cofactors controlling PTEN and PD-L1 transcription, while confusables emphasize BAF assembly, histone acetylation or DNA/histone methylation.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum cycling and store-operated entry
name: Muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and store-operated entry
rationale: Members concern ryanodine-receptor release, SR/ER calcium uptake, sodium/calcium exchange and store-operated entry controlling cardiac and skeletal contraction, which confusables about fiber type, gap junctions or action potentials lack.

name: Transsulfuration and sulfur catabolism with B6 and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine, sulfide and alkanesulfonate catabolism together with PLP (vitamin B6) and molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis, unlike serine/proline, BH4 or selenium confusables.

name: Factor VIII and IX defects in intrinsic coagulation
rationale: All members are defective F8 or F9 functions or the intrinsic coagulation pathway they act in, whereas confusables cover VWF, FV, FXII, fibrin and fibrinolysis.

name: Classical and alternative complement activation and its regulation
rationale: Members are classical and alternative complement activation and its positive and negative regulation, while confusables hold lectin/ficolin, C3/C5 and GZMK activation or hypersensitivity.

name: Reactive astrocyte gliosis, glial migration and proliferation
rationale: Members concern astrocyte activation, migration and glial proliferation in reactive gliosis, which confusables centred on oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell myelination lack.

name: B cell proliferation, survival and homeostasis, including CD27 signaling
rationale: Members regulate B cell proliferation, apoptosis, homeostasis, B-1 differentiation and germinal centre formation, including CD27 signaling, unlike the BCR-signaling and Tfh/GC-differentiation confusables.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3:SMAD4 signaling and its downregulation
rationale: Members are canonical TGF-beta signaling via SMAD2/3:SMAD4 and its negative regulation, distinct from cancer-mutant, RUNX3 and TGFBR3/activin confusables.

qualifier: NEIL glycosylases through long-patch gap filling
name: Base excision repair: NEIL glycosylases through long-patch gap filling
rationale: Members span glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases, NEIL1/NEIL3 defects and short- and long-patch gap filling, unlike confusables with OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects or alkylation reversal.

core: B cell receptor signaling and development
name: BCR signaling and B cell development, with inhibitory regulation
rationale: Members cover antigen-BCR second messengers, BTK/RAS activation, CD22 and negative regulation of BCR signaling, and B cell development, which confusables focused on CD27, survival or generic B-cell modules lack.

name: Collagen, laminin and integrin adhesion with VWF variants
rationale: Members are integrin, laminin and collagen interactions and basement membrane organization plus VWF variants affecting collagen/GPIb binding, distinct from platelet signaling, hemidesmosome and collagen crosslinking confusables.

name: Kainate and AMPA receptor excitatory transmission and excitotoxicity
rationale: Members are AMPA and kainate receptor activation, excitatory transmission, short-term plasticity and kainate-induced hippocampal neuron death, unlike presynaptic kainate/GABA and NMDA-focused confusables.

name: Axon guidance receptor signaling to Rho-family GTPases
rationale: Members are ROBO-SLIT, ephrin and DCC signaling acting through RAC1, CDC42 and RHOA, whereas confusables emphasize commissural pathfinding, L1 and netrin repulsion.

name: TNFR1 and RIP1-mediated canonical NF-kappaB activation via linear ubiquitination
rationale: Members cover TNFR1 signaling, RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment and linear polyubiquitination driving canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables on non-canonical NF-kappaB, IRAK-TLR signaling or NF-kappaB inhibition.

name: OGG1 glycosylase defects in 8-oxoguanine base excision repair
rationale: All three members are defective OGG1 localization, binding or processing, while confusables cover other glycosylases, gap filling or alkylation repair.

name: Homology-directed DSB repair: end resection and single-strand annealing
rationale: Members concern DSB end processing, single-strand annealing and BRCA2-RAD51 binding defects, distinct from NHEJ/ATM sensing and PALB2/BRCA1 HRR-defect confusables.

name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis from DHA, EPA, DPA
rationale: All members are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins and maresins from docosahexaenoic, eicosapentaenoic and docosapentaenoic acids, whereas confusables cover arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs and leukotrienes.

qualifier: epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary gland
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members are epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, mesenchymal proliferation and branching in lung, trachea, salivary gland and limb bud, unlike prostate, pancreas/kidney or alveolar-differentiation confusables.
